2025 World Cup

The 2026 Openfront World Cup is the biggest tournament of the year 2026, bringing the best of Openfront on a World Cup style format of Trios.

About

Format

  • Group Stage - May 16th & 17th, 2026
    • 4 trio matches played using a match-point system in pools of 4, 6 pools in total
    • Teams earn points based on their maximum land size reached during each match
  • Point Distribution (per match)
      • 1st: 5 points
      • 2nd: 3 points
      • 3rd: 1 point
      • 4th: 0 points


    • Top two teams of each group advance to the 2026 Openfront Spring Major. The 4 best 3rd place teams also advance
  • Scoring Method
    • At the end of each match, referees record the largest territory size each team reached at any moment during the game
    • Teams are ranked using this maximum land value, and points are awarded accordingly
  • Tie-Breaker Rule
    • In case of equal points, they are decided by overall wins or domination over the other team they are tied with.

Prize Pool

  • Unique Pattern – awarded to all teams that advanced the group stage
  • In-Game currency - Caps for group stage, Plutonium for Finals
  • Clan Store - for winning clan
  • Custom Nation Flag - for Finalists
  • The following is awarded to the winners of the event in addition to the previous items:
    • Unique Bomb Pattern
    • Custom 1/1 skins
